name: MonarchSaveStatusIndicator
title: SaveStatusIndicator
summary: A small inline status for saving: "Saving…", "Saved · 2 minutes ago" or "Couldn't save" with a Retry button.
whenToUse: In an editor's top bar, next to a form's actions or under a field that saves on its own, so people know whether their edits are safe.
whenNotToUse: For a save the user started with a button and then leaves the screen, confirm with a snackbar. For the age of synced data, use MonarchFreshnessIndicator.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSaveStatusIndicator(status: MonarchSaveStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, announceSaving: Boolean = false, savedAt: Long? = null, errorMessage: String? = null, icon: (@Composable (MonarchSaveStatus) -> Unit)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels = MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels())
enum class MonarchSaveStatus { Idle, Unsaved, Saving, Saved, Error }
class MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels(unsaved: String? = null, saving: String? = null, saved: String? = null, error: String? = null, retry: String? = null)

options.name: status
options.description: Idle (nothing drawn), Unsaved, Saving, Saved or Error.

options.name: announceSaving
options.description: Also announces "Saving…". Off by default so autosaves stay quiet.

options.name: savedAt
options.description: When the last save finished, in epoch milliseconds (UTC); shown as relative time after "Saved" and redrawn every minute.

options.name: icon
options.description: Replaces the dot for Unsaved, Saved and Error, for example a check mark. Tinted with the status color.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a Retry button to the error status.

states.name: idle
states.description: Nothing is drawn; the live region stays.

states.name: saving
states.description: A small progress ring and "Saving…"; a still dot when animations are off.

states.name: saved
states.description: A success dot (or the icon), "Saved" and the relative time. Announced.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger dot, the error in danger text and the Retry button. Announced.

appearance: Caption text in the muted text color; the error text in the strong danger color. The mark takes subtle text while saving and the strong success, warning or danger color for saved, unsaved and error. Retry is a small ghost MonarchButton. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web uses check, warning and dot glyphs; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the mark is a dot unless the app passes icon, and the words always carry the status. The web announces through a polite live region, as here; iOS posts an announcement. Times are epoch milliseconds, formatted with DateUtils. iOS shares the name and the statuses.
accessibility: The mark, the status and the time are one TalkBack element read as "Saved, 2 minutes ago"; the mark and the middle dot are hidden.
A change to Saved or Error is announced through a polite live region on a node that is always present; Saving only with announceSaving. The first status is not announced.
The live region is emptied for a frame before each announcement, so a second "Saved" is announced again.
Retry is a separate button with a 48dp touch target.
The progress ring is replaced by a still dot when animations are off.
Long error messages wrap at the largest font size.
edgeCases: savedAt is shown only with Saved.
onRetry without the Error status shows no button.
A save that fails with the same message twice is announced twice.
